title: An ordinary portrait becomes sexual blackmail
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes criminals altering ordinary photographs into sexual imagery. They threaten to circulate the fabricated material unless the target pays.
suggested_beats: A familiar portrait is misused.
A fake sexual image accompanies a demand.
Seek reporting support without paying.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose portrait is publicly accessible
why_it_works: Fear of reputational damage can create pressure even when an image is fake.

title: A fabricated image demands real intimate material
mechanism_summary: Criminals use manipulated sexual images to threaten a target. Their demand is for genuine intimate content rather than money.
suggested_beats: A fabricated image arrives.
The sender demands real intimate material.
Stop contact and seek support.
why_it_works: A threat to expose a fabrication can be used to obtain new leverage.

title: A coworker distributes a sexual forgery
mechanism_summary: An official example describes a coworker creating an AI sexual deepfake of another worker. The fabricated image is emailed around the workplace.
suggested_beats: A colleague's image is altered.
The forgery reaches coworkers.
Report the abuse through safe workplace and platform channels.
why_it_works: Workplace circulation turns a fabrication into immediate social pressure.

title: An acquaintance is placed in a fabricated sexual video
mechanism_summary: A public charging account alleges that ordinary images of acquaintances were transformed into sexual videos with AI. The material was published without the depicted people's consent.
suggested_beats: An ordinary image is obtained.
A fabricated sexual video is published.
Report the posting without amplifying it.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose acquaintance misuses their image
why_it_works: Familiar likenesses make fabricated scenes personally damaging.

title: Bulk sexual forgeries become a public archive
mechanism_summary: A public charging account describes AI sexual images organized into online albums. Publishing many forgeries exposes depicted people to repeated unwanted viewing and circulation.
suggested_beats: Fabricated images are collected.
Albums make the abuse widely accessible.
Report abusive collections without sharing them.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone depicted in a nonconsensual synthetic collection
why_it_works: Scale and repeat exposure can deepen the harm of a false depiction.

title: A public profile supplies likenesses for sexual websites
mechanism_summary: An enforcement announcement describes websites publishing nude digital forgeries of public-facing women. The sites exploit recognizable likenesses without consent.
suggested_beats: A public likeness is copied.
A website publishes a sexual forgery.
Report the content and avoid recirculation.
why_it_works: Public recognition creates an audience for an abusive fabrication.

title: A loan app turns contact access into humiliation
mechanism_summary: A reported loan-app case describes digitally altered intimate images used for blackmail. The images were sent to the borrower's contacts as part of the pressure.
suggested_beats: A loan application obtains personal access.
Altered images reach contacts.
Report coercion and seek trusted help.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone borrowing through an unfamiliar app
why_it_works: Access to a social circle makes a fabricated image a coercive threat.

title: A sexual forgery circulates without a money demand
mechanism_summary: An official guide identifies fake intimate imagery as image-based abuse. Circulation can harm someone without any extortion demand.
suggested_beats: An intimate forgery appears online.
Others spread it without consent.
Report it and do not forward it.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone targeted by nonconsensual synthetic imagery
why_it_works: Viewers may mistake visual realism for evidence.
